name: Wheeler's Fleeing Steeds
summary: Benjy asks you to find a horse that fled Wheeler's Grange after coyotes attacked. Feed it so it trusts you and can be led back.

sections.title: Fled from the Grange
sections.body: Benjy at Wheeler's Grange needs your help finding one of the horses that fled the coyote attack. Some horses were taken by coyotes, while others ran off in fear. Give a horse some feed so it will trust you and let you lead it back.

faq.answer: Coyotes got most of the horses, while some fled from Wheeler's Grange in fear.
Benjy asks you to find a horse that fled Wheeler's Grange.

faq.q: What should I do with the feed?
faq.answer: Give some of the feed to a horse so it trusts you and can be led back.

faq.q: Why are the horses being sought?
faq.answer: Benjy says the escaped horses should be found before the coyotes return.
